## Incident Overview
Two tests fail on a clean tree (verified via git stash on origin/main HEAD, 2026-06-06):
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_inbound_leaf_bodies.py::test_apply_honours_suppress_pair_drops_subsequent_inbound
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_inbound_leaf_bodies.py::test_apply_honours_suppress_pair_drops_subsequent_inbound_via_computed_form

22 pass / 2 fail in that file, in isolation, independent of any current change (reproduced identically on the stashed baseline). 

## Context
Both concern the applier's suppress_pair inbound-mutation dispatch path (applier.py ~2737-2752 inbound loop, follow_on kind=suppress_pair). This is the same fragile inbound-dispatch area documented in meta-bug f6cc comment #8 (inbound-mutation dispatch). 

## Discovered during
Blast-radius verification for the a666/4cc1 dedup-cluster fix (PR #686) — confirmed NOT a regression from that change. Filed per CLAUDE.md always:tracking-issues.
